WHAT SURVIVES: server.py:3241-3253 carries positions/playerIds/idToPlayer/scoringSettings/rosterPositions/leagueSettings forward from the LOADED league and then unconditionally stamps meta['sleeperDataReady']=True at :3259, so /api/data?leagueKey=dynasty_new returns sleeperDataReady:true AND sleeperLoadedLeagueKey:'dynasty_main' together — the combination CLAUDE.md's contract annotations say cannot occur. The chimera is real and I verified it against the live Sleeper host, not the repo snapshot: dynasty_new is genuinely 10 teams / 27 slots / 48 scoring keys / rec 1.0 / no idp_sack, and the served block is 12 / 58 / 141 / 0.08 / 2.92. dynasty_new is active:true and idpEnabled:false in config/leagues/registry.json, so it is user-selectable. lineupSlots() on the served array yields 21 starter slots including 3 DL / 3 LB / 3 DB / 1 K for a league with none of those positions, versus 10 real — the finding's number, confirmed. WHAT DIES: (a) 'un-gates every team-dependent page' is the wrong frame. On /trade (page.jsx:182) and /waivers (page.jsx:620) the ONLY sleeper field read is `teams`, which the overlay supplies correctly for dynasty_new. On those two pages sleeperDataReady:true is the CORRECT answer — the whole point of the cross-league overlay is to make them work — and forcing false there would delete working multi-league functionality to satisfy a doc table. The defect is not the flag being true; it is that the flag certifies fields that were never overlaid. (b) The cited userImpact chain is misattributed: portfolio-insights.js:105 is imported by terminal/PortfolioSummary.jsx and terminal/ScoutingIntel.jsx and by nothing else. /trade and /waivers never touch it. The wrong 21-slot IDP lineup lands on /rosters (page.jsx:61 feeds buildRosterAnalysis + scoreTeamTiers) and /terminal. (c) blastRadius.playersAffected:1092 is not defensible — not one player value is wrong here. The board is shared across leagues on the same scoringProfile BY DESIGN, and the finding itself does not dispute the values. Zero players are mispriced; what is wrong is league CONFIG. (d) scoringSettings and leagueSettings have NO frontend consumer at all (verified by grep across frontend/ for scoringSettings/num_teams/numTeams — zero hits on the sleeper block), so 128 of the 144 mismatched settings are inert on the /api/data path. WHAT I FOUND THAT BROADENS IT: the identical carry-forward-then-stamp-true pattern is duplicated in three more handlers — /api/terminal (server.py:10577-10586), /api/trade/simulate (:10798-10804) and /api/signal-alerts/run (:11653-11659) — so routesAffected is 4, not 2, and the trade-simulate one runs server-side where the frontend grep cannot see it. src/bdvm/league_config.py:194-196 also reads all three fields, but from latest_contract_data rather than the per-request hybrid, so it is a separate leak, not this one. P1 is correct and I am leaving it there: a reachable page (/rosters, /terminal) shows a materially wrong starter/bench split for dynasty_new, but no traded value is misquoted and the wrong lineup is visibly absurd (K and IDP slots in a league with neither) rather than plausibly wrong.
